ns2:course.label: Introduction to Finance
ns2:course.description: Introduction to financial management and decision making. A customized course, designed to provide a survey of finance for graduate students who do not necessarily have previous training in the disciplines. Different sections of the course will cover different sets of topics. Prerequisite: Graduate standing or consent of department.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate standing or consent of department.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS: Financial Engineering.
